name: MudiAppVR
summary: Step inside Agrigento Cathedral as never before. Created for MUDIA – the Diocesan Museum of Agrigento, MudiAppVR takes you through the cathedral's four historical eras: Norman, Chiaramonte, Renaissance and Baroque. Each environment is rebuilt in virtual reality with photogrammetry-scanned statues and architecture, guided by a narrated story. About 7 minutes, available in Italian, English, French, Spanish and German.
